name: guildhall
description: A pixel town of every live Claude Code session, in the terminal

scripts.build: npm run --silent build:cli && npm run --silent build:web
scripts.build:web: npm run --silent build:js && npm run --silent build:css
scripts.release: npm run --silent docs && npm run --silent build:web && git add -A docs web/app.js && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Refresh the generated documentation images and browser bundle") && npm run check && npm version ${npm_config_level:-patch} -m "Release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm test && npm run check:docs && npm run check:web && npm run check:perf && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:spelling
